name: Financial Services Metadata Schema
description: Required metadata for AI agents, capabilities, and resources operating in regulated financial-services contexts.

fields.name: sector
fields.description: Sector classification. MUST resolve to a registered KYETaxonomyTerm under the sector taxonomy.

fields.name: jurisdiction
fields.description: ISO-3166 jurisdiction. Drives PSD3 vs FFIEC vs MAS vs RBI evidence routing.

fields.name: data_classes
fields.description: Array of registered data_class taxonomy terms (financial, personal_data, special_category, regulated, public).

fields.name: ai_risk_class
fields.description: EU AI Act risk classification. high_risk drives KYE-EUAIACT-003 obligations.

fields.name: criticality
fields.description: Operational criticality tier (tier_1 / tier_2 / tier_3) — drives DORA Article 6 critical-function evidence.
